kinds.desc: Native BGP via an embedded GoBGP instance — named instances that can advertise VIP/pod CIDRs and import routes between instances, no external speaker needed.
Install a blackhole route to silently drop traffic to a prefix.
Bond several links into one for link aggregation / failover, choosing a bonding mode.
Create a software L2 bridge and enslave links to it.

Set the cpufreq governor, energy-performance preference and min/max frequency for the CPU frequency policies matched by a CEL selector (e.g. only performance cores). First document by name wins a policy; removing it restores the boot values. Cannot be combined with cpufreq keys in `SysfsConfig`.
Set the containerd base OCI runtime spec applied to all containers.
Layer additional containerd/CRI config customizations (dedicated doc, replaces inline file tweaks).

Run a container directly on the node without Kubernetes: started as soon as the config is applied, in the dedicated `taloscontainers` CRI namespace, auto-restarted 5s after it exits. Not a Talos service (`talosctl services` won't list it); status comes from the `ContainerStatus` resource.

Declare a content library: a flat store of VM images at the root of a user/existing/external volume, filled over the API with `talosctl hypervisor content-library upload`, never by editing config. One volume backs one library; read-only volumes are rejected. Status: `ContentLibraryStatus`.
Tune the DHCPv4 client per link. v1.14 adds `ignoreRoutes`; `skipHostnameRequest` avoids DHCP hostname override.
Tune the DHCPv6 client per link.
Holds the cluster ID and shared secret (extracted from v1alpha1) that identify the cluster to discovery.
Configure the external discovery service registry endpoint used for node discovery.

Collect disk SMART health data on an interval (default 30m). The document's presence enables collection — removing it disables it and drops the `smart` resources; spun-down rotational disks are left alone.
Create a dummy interface (a stable local address holder / blackhole).
Set machine-wide environment variables (replaces `.machine.env`).
Declaratively manage files under /etc (name/contents/mode).
Tune NIC hardware settings: ring buffers, channels, features (offloads), and WoL.
Send Talos runtime events to an external gRPC sink.
Adopt an already-formatted volume (by selector) without wiping it, and mount it.
Provide runtime config (env, files, args) to an installed extension service.
Reference storage provisioned/attached outside Talos (e.g. iSCSI/cloud disk) so it can be mounted.
Schedule periodic online filesystem scrubbing (xfs_scrub / btrfs scrub) on filesystems that support it (min interval 10s).
Schedule periodic `fstrim` on SSD-backed volumes (default 7-day interval), with a per-volume `trim:` override.
Manage a Hetzner Cloud floating IP as a VIP via the cloud API.
Define an HTTP reachability probe used by network readiness logic.
Set the node hostname (and domain).
Enable the local image cache (`local.enabled: true`) — the canonical replacement for `.machine.features.imageCache.localEnabled`.
Machine-wide container image signature verification policy.
Load kernel modules with options (multi-doc, replaces `.machine.kernel.modules`).
Ship kernel/service logs to a remote sink (UDP/TCP json_lines).
The Kubernetes API server CA cert/key (extracted from the secrets bundle).
kube-apiserver settings: extra args, extra volumes, cert SANs, admission.
Admission controller / PodSecurity configuration for the API server.
The front-proxy/aggregator CA used for the API aggregation layer.
API server audit policy.
API server authentication config (e.g. structured auth / OIDC).
API server authorization mode/config (e.g. structured authz).
Cluster-wide Kubernetes base settings (name, dns domain, cluster-level toggles) extracted from v1alpha1 `.cluster`.
kube-controller-manager extra args and volumes.
Cluster DNS (CoreDNS) settings, or disabling the managed deployment.
Kubelet image credential provider config for registry auth.
Encryption-at-rest config for Kubernetes secrets in etcd.
Bootstrap manifests fetched from external URLs at cluster bootstrap.
Flannel CNI settings; `backendMTU` now auto-aligns to the KubeSpan MTU.
Bootstrap manifests embedded inline, applied once at cluster bootstrap.
Pod/service CIDRs and cluster networking (moved out of `.cluster.network`); supports per-node pod CIDR.
Per-node Kubernetes settings extracted from the v1alpha1 `.cluster`/`.machine` blocks.
KubePrism — the local load-balancing API endpoint on each node (replaces `.machine.features.kubePrism`).
kube-proxy settings (mode, extra args), or disabling it for eBPF CNIs.
kube-scheduler extra args, config, and volumes.
Service-account issuer/signing key configuration.
Enable/configure KubeSpan — Talos's automatic WireGuard mesh between all cluster nodes.
Provide extra/override endpoints for KubeSpan peers (e.g. behind NAT).
Define extra static pods to run on nodes (moved out of `.machine.pods`).
Controls whether/which Talos API access is granted to workloads in Kubernetes (moved out of Kubernetes config).
Kubelet configuration (replaces `.machine.kubelet`): extra args, node IP, feature gates, extra mounts.
Declaratively define logical volumes in a VG (linear/raid0/raid1/raid10). Reconcile is additive-only — shrinking errors out.
Declaratively define an LVM volume group from matching physical volumes/disks.
Configure a shared/floating layer-2 VIP for HA control planes (gratuitous-ARP failover).
Give a link a stable alias/selector so config can target it by predictable name rather than kernel name (eth0/enp3s0).
Configure a physical/logical network link: up/down, MTU, and whether it participates in DHCP.
Create a MACVLAN link over a parent link — a second MAC address on the same physical NIC.
Set the default ingress firewall policy (accept vs block) that the rules refine.
Declare an ingress firewall rule (ports/protocols/sources) for the host.
Configure the userspace OOM handler: CEL trigger/ranking expressions for which cgroup to kill under memory pressure.
Rebind a PCI device to a different kernel driver (e.g. hand a NIC/GPU to vfio-pci for passthrough).
Declaratively provision a Linux MD (software RAID) array from matching disks; Talos can boot from a RAID1 array.
Provision a raw (unformatted) partition to hand to a CSI driver or app that manages its own format.
Provide pull credentials for a registry.
Point a registry (e.g. docker.io) at one or more mirror endpoints; replaces `.machine.registries.mirrors`.
Provide TLS settings (CA/insecure/client cert) for a registry.
Set DNS nameservers and search domains. v1.14 adds per-server protocol (Do53/DoT/DoH) + host DNS caching options; `domains` override DHCP search domains.
Add policy routing rules (rule table selection by src/fwmark).
Adjust machine security profile settings (e.g. seccomp/hardening toggles).
Configure the SideroLink point-to-point WireGuard management overlay (used by Omni).
Add static host-to-IP mappings resolved locally.

Define a libvirt directory storage pool (holds VM disk volumes) at `<volume mount>/<pool name>` on a writable user/existing/external volume. Requires the libvirt system extension; removing the document undefines the pool but keeps its files. Status: `StoragePoolStatus`.
Provision a swap volume (optionally encrypted); pairs with Kubernetes swap support.
Set kernel sysctls (replaces `.machine.sysctls`); config generate emits it as a multi-doc.
Set /sys attributes (replaces `.machine.sysfs`).
Define a TCP reachability probe used by network readiness logic.
Configure NTP time servers.
Add extra trusted CA root certificates machine-wide (for corporate TLS interception or private registries).
Add udev rules (additive to the legacy `.machine.udev` field).
Drive fully automated, hands-off installation (no interactive/maintenance step).
Carve a user-defined volume out of a selected disk (CEL selector), pick size and filesystem (ext4/xfs, btrfs in v1.14). Mounted under /var/mnt.
Create 802.1Q VLAN sub-interfaces on a parent link.
Create a VRF (virtual routing & forwarding) device to isolate a routing table.
Create a VXLAN (Virtual eXtensible LAN) overlay link over a parent link.
Create a veth (virtual ethernet) pair — two linked interfaces, typically to wire a namespace/bridge together.

Declare a virtual machine run by Talos through libvirt: power state, vCPUs with an optional host-CPU millicore ceiling, memory and ballooning, UEFI/BIOS firmware with secure boot, disks in a storage pool (blank or from a content-library image), NICs on host links, serial/VNC consoles. Work in progress: VMs with disks are not started yet.
Customize built-in system volumes (EPHEMERAL, and per-service overrides for CRI/kubelet/etcd): disk selector, size, encryption. One-time provisioning for system volumes.
Arm a hardware watchdog so a wedged node auto-reboots.
Manually configure a WireGuard interface (peers, keys, allowed IPs) as a plain overlay — distinct from KubeSpan.
Enable zswap — a compressed RAM cache in front of swap devices.
